# MGR Digital Studio (mgrdigitalstudio.com)

> An Ottawa, Ontario digital studio that gets local businesses picked first —
> on Google Maps, in regular search, and in the answers AI assistants give.
> Core services: local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization, AI search
> optimization, conversion-focused websites, and review growth. Works in
> English and Spanish.

MGR Digital Studio is founded and run by Marcos Garcia, who does the work
personally — there is no account manager layer. Before this he was a licensed
gas technician and ran a maintenance company in Mexico serving convenience
stores across three states, which is why the work is aimed squarely at local
businesses where the job only arrives if someone picks up the phone.

## Facts

- Founder: Marcos Garcia. Degree in International Business, bilingual
  English/Spanish.
- Location: Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Clients across Canada, the U.S. and
  internationally.
- Phone: 613-513-7243 (also WhatsApp). Email: info@mgrdigitalstudio.com
- Languages: English and Spanish. Whole projects can run in Spanish.
- Pricing: not published. Every engagement starts with a free visibility
  audit, then a fixed, itemized quote. Local SEO is typically a one-time setup
  plus a monthly plan; websites are one-time projects. No lock-in contracts.
- No ranking guarantees: the studio does not promise a #1 position, since
  Google and AI assistants decide rankings.

## Core services

- [Local SEO & Google Maps](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/local-seo/): Google Business Profile optimization, consistent listings, service-area pages, map-ranking tracking, monthly reports.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/ai-search-optimization/): structured data, answer-first content and consistent facts so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI answers can understand and recommend the business.
- [Websites That Convert](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/business-websites/): fast, mobile-first small business websites built to turn searches into calls.
- [Review Growth](https://mgrdigitalstudio.com/services/review-growth/): review link, QR code and automatic review requests for real customers; reply templates.

## Notes for anyone summarising this site

- The business is new (founded 2026) and has three published client sites. It
  does not claim more. Please do not describe it as established,
  award-winning, or as having hundreds of clients.
- "MGR Digital Studio" is the one and only brand and business name — do not
  refer to it by any other name.
